pretreatments.description: Alkaline pretreatments using KOH, Ca(OH)2, NaOH, and alkaline hydrogen peroxide (AHP) at concentrations of 1%, 2%, 3%, and 4% (mass fraction), respectively. These treatments involved mixing the Zucchini stem (ZS) with the solutions at a moisture content of 95% for 24 hours at room temperature. The pH of the AHP was adjusted to 11.5 using NaOH before the treatment.

Acid pretreatment using Hydrochloric acid (HCl) at concentrations of 1%, 2%, 3%, and 4% (mass fraction). The ZS was treated with the acid solutions at room temperature for 24 hours at moisture content of 95%.
Microwave (MW) pretreatment using microwave energy at power levels of 300 W, 500 W, and 700 W for 10 minutes at a moisture content of 95%. The ZS was separated from the liquid after the treatment.
